name: qa-control-center
description: QA Control Center — consolidates QA matrices, evidence, defects and reports

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@qacc/shared && npm run build --workspace=@qacc/api && npm run build --workspace=@qacc/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@qacc/api && npm run lint --workspace=@qacc/web
